original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independently reconstruct the V45 rank-7 group and losing single-helper control from both pinned PR2942 parent providers, replay the profile-bearing sections through the five stage-2 extraction transforms and fourteen stage-3 rewrites, reproduce all local profiles and weighted deltas, independently rebuild the literal T74 owner windows/roles/stock count, and apply exact local-only moment floors at kappa=0.1 to the reconstructed PR2979 profile and the exact PR3042 six-skip profile used by the later T740 composition.
scope_change_reason: After the bounded V45 and aggregate audit, a separate literal replay of stages 2/3 closed the missing source-binding for paid profile fields in both providers. The T74 handoff motivated an independent schedule/window and bin checker, using no owner engine or producer imports. The donor's target kappa=0.1 then motivated exact integer-power lower bounds on the reconstructed PR2979 profile and a newer six-skip profile pinned from PR3042; both floors apply only to their fixed local profiles under the inherited moment/transfer. None of these checks certifies compensation, cleanup semantics, operator identities, global stock admission, or outer release.
bottleneck_link: The complex supplier is the selected binding side. An independent frame and price reconstruction tests whether the claimed coordinated group actually changes the local rank/width profile and whether the published T74 aggregate pays that local profile.
stop_rule: Do not run another lowering census or claim a new selected kappa until the extraction/rewrite identities, compensation and cleanup, T74 owner chronology, physical/native admission and outer release receive source-bound review.
evidence: verify.py independently derives F2 spans by XOR closure, reconstructs the V45 and five-group profiles for both providers, then source-replays the five extraction transforms and fourteen literal rewrites to reproduce the profile-bearing final word sections, all published stage prices, and the final profile/inventory. Omitted-frame, stale-preimage and unshifted-warp controls reject. It independently simulates the T74 call order, derives 1,332 owner-child windows, checks all 271,728 role records and their rank-coordinate packing, rejects malformed chronology/missing roles/family collisions/capacity overflow, and reconciles rank mass 4,816,512 plus the 66,813 physical stock formula. At target kappa=1/10 (a=1/9), verified integer ninth-root floors give the reconstructed PR2979 local profile a moment lower bound 48304277901/44800000000 > 1 and the exact PR3042 six-skip claim profile a lower bound 48295445607/44800000000 > 1, both before idle or centre charges. PR3054 reports composing that unchanged local word with a T740 allocation. The 90-digit Decimal root is only a numerical cross-check. The extraction/rewrite operator identities, compensation/cleanup semantics, global stock/native admission and outer release remain open. Canonical main refreshed successfully at d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641, priority revision 6; the new PR3042/3054 lineage was checked before submission. GitHub #2979 is merged for archive only, and selected-result still names #1094. The overlap corpus refreshed 332 open PRs and 1,852 discussions at 2026-10-16 23:43 UTC; it found #3015 and #3042 as closer active descendants, which motivated the second target screen. No current novelty claim is made beyond the exact scoped checks.
